Mode chips: Immersive, AI Insights, AI Lab. F3 cycles them.
State, algorithm, chosen action, target lane, forecast
probability and time until the attack.
"Why?" gives the grounded reason, including the guarantee
that an action-free escape lane stays open (T3).
The danger cue is red and in words: "Boulder locked, Centre.
The 76% is a real Markov-model forecast of the player's
lane, not an invented confidence. Cyan is used only for AI
